messages:
alyssa: Heads up — seeing a weird quality regression after int4 quantizing mistral-7b and serving the converted model under our llama runtime. Perplexity at token ~512 jumps ~3x compared to fp16 baseline.

mano: Can you paste the tiny repro + logs?

alyssa: Quick snippet from the eval run:
```
STEP: generate 512 tokens, temp=0.7
fp16 ppl: 12.3
int4 ppl: 38.9
first divergence token id: 94723
kv_cache warning: head=2 phase_offset=64 expected=0
```

jon: That kv_cache phase_offset line looks suspicious. Did the converter preserve rotary params (scale/phase) headwise?

alyssa: We used the standard convert_mistral_to_llama.py with default flags. I grep'd the converted model attrs and found `rotary_scale=None` on the first 6 heads but non-null on others.

evan: We ran into something similar last quarter with a headwise-rope mismatch — if rotor params are stored per-head but the runtime expects a global pair, you can get per-head phase slips that only show up in long-context generative runs.

mano: Quick checklist: tokenizer IDs mapping? byte-level merges? and embed layout (proj before/after)? Any token aliasing on boundary tokens could blow early history and change KV alignment.

alyssa: Tokenizer mapping looks OK on short sequences. The divergence only shows after ~200 tokens which points at KV/rotary drift rather than early tokenization.

ci-bot: smoke-eval #2432: int4-mistral-llama-conversion: FAILED (ppl regression > 2x)

mano: Can you run a minimal diff between q/k projections pre/post-conversion (hash each tensor headwise)? If the converter swapped head ordering or transposed a dim it would explain this.

alyssa: Running quick head-hash check now:
```bash
python - <<'PY'
import torch, hashlib
m = torch.load('converted/model.pt', map_location='cpu')
q = m['layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight']
k = m['layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.weight']
# compute per-head digest
head_size = 64
hashes = [hashlib.md5(q[:, i*head_size:(i+1)*head_size].numpy()).hexdigest() for i in range(q.shape[1]//head_size)]
print(hashes[:8])
PY
```

jon: Also check the `rope` entries: some convertors store `rotary_base` or `rotary_scale` with float32 but then quantize them to int8 leading to tiny phase offsets when dequantized. Try comparing `rotary_angle` float32 vs reconstructed from int8 quant tables.

evan: Another thought: our runtime applies a headwise KV packing optimization that assumes head ordering matches layout [head, dim]. If converter produced [dim, head] we might still run but with strange headwise mixing that surfaces in long contexts.

alyssa: Good point. I diffed shapes and transposes look identical but head ordering mismatch is subtle. I'll run the per-head cosine similarity between q and k across models and also compare roation matrices.

mano: If you can reproduce locally, add `--preserve-rotary-phase` and `--no-head-packing` flags to conversion and serve that on a dev slot. If that fixes it, we'll know packing vs rotary.

alyssa: Trying `python convert.py --src mistral --dst llama --no-head-packing --preserve-rotary-phase` now. Will post results in ~15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: job convert-1245 queued (dev-gpu-7).

jon: Also add a tiny unit test: feed identical prefix and compare kv_cache keys after first forward; equality should catch head shuffles quickly. Example: `assert torch.allclose(k1, k2, atol=1e-6)`

alyssa: Added test to repo under `tests/interop/test_kv_headwise.py` and pushed. Link: https://git.internal/r/infra/conv/changes/482 (private).

manO: if fixed, we should add a fuzz test that randomized head orderings to converter CI - catches future regressions.

evan: Agreed. Also flagging runtime: maybe make head-packing opt-in until we prove converters keep layout stable.

alyssa: Update: fresh converted model with flags looks much closer — int4 ppl down to 13.8 on the same eval set. Still slightly worse than fp16 but not catastrophic.

mano: Nice. Could be rotary quantization granularity or small numeric drift; but sounds like head packing was the main culprit.

jon: Please open a short postmortem and add the conversion flags to the onboarding checklist for mistral->llama.

alyssa: Will do — filing ticket now and will add CI fuzz test. Thanks all :thumbsup:
